name: Xero
summary: Xero is cloud accounting with three US plans priced per organization, not per user: the page states no per-user license fees. Bank feeds and bank reconciliation come with every plan, and the entry plan caps sending at 20 invoices and 5 bills a month. Xero states SOC 2 reports and ISO 27001 certification, which few small business tools match.

facts.text: Xero's US pricing page lists an 80% discount for the first 3 months for new US customers buying their first organization.
The pricing page says Xero has no per-user license fees.
Xero's accounting software page says it integrates with 1000+ apps.
Xero states that it produces SOC 2 reports from independent audits and is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
Xero describes its general ledger as building itself as transactions are entered.

plans.name: Early
plans.notes: Send quotes and 20 invoices, enter 5 bills. Listed promotion: $5.40 a month for the first 3 months

plans.name: Growing
plans.notes: Listed promotion: $11.80 a month for the first 3 months

plans.name: Established
plans.notes: Listed promotion: $19.40 a month for the first 3 months

hiddenCosts: The 80% promotion covers base plan subscriptions for the first 3 months only, not add-ons, usage or payment fees, and Xero can change or cancel it at any time.
The Early plan caps invoices at 20 and bills at 5, and the invoice cap applies to approving as well as sending.

contract.cancellation: The pricing page says subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled.
